prompts.frontier-map: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production pixel-art illustration for a cozy fantasy idle expedition game. Landscape 3:2. Exquisite crisp retro RPG pixel clusters, clean silhouettes, restrained sage-green / teal / warm cream / copper palette, lovingly layered scenery, consistent readable pixel texture. Calm adventurous mood, gentle light. No text, lettering, numbers, UI, labels, watermarks or borders. No player characters. A top-down illustrated frontier map with three connected distinct expedition destinations: a turquoise firefly woodland trail with little stone bridges at lower left, an amber-and-violet crystal ravine with an old mining lift in the middle, and an ancient ivy-covered stone sanctuary on a cliff at upper right. A winding pale road connects a tiny tent camp at the bottom left, a little supply wagon, the forest, ravine and sanctuary. Rivers and waterfalls, wooden bridges, rocky cliffs, tiny watchtowers and a navigable central road. Make the three landmarks clearly separated, fill nearly the whole composition, a little dark teal water around the border. Beautiful detailed hand-pixelated world-building.
